summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the Un-convert Property Lead feature. All backend API tests passed (6/6). All frontend UI tests passed. The feature allows users to revert a property lead that was previously converted to a showcase listing.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/property-leads/{lead_id}/unconvert returns 400 for non-converted leads
Backend: POST /api/property-leads/{lead_id}/unconvert returns 404 for non-existent leads
Backend: GET /api/property-leads/{lead_id} returns converted lead with converted_to_listing_id
Backend: Convert then unconvert with delete_listing=true - listing deleted, status reset to 'new'
Backend: Convert then unconvert with delete_listing=false - listing preserved, status reset
Backend: Activity log updated with 'unconverted' entry after un-convert
Frontend: 'Un-convert Lead' button appears ONLY for converted leads
Frontend: 'View Showcase Listing' button appears for converted leads with listing ID
Frontend: 'Convert to Showcase Listing' button appears ONLY for non-converted leads
Frontend: Confirmation dialogs work correctly (two-step: delete option + confirmation)
Frontend: 'View Showcase Listing' navigates correctly to /listings/{id}
Frontend: Lead detail page shows correct status badges (CONVERTED vs NEW)

features_verified.delete_listing_true: When delete_listing=true, the showcase listing is deleted from properties collection
features_verified.delete_listing_false: When delete_listing=false, the showcase listing is preserved
features_verified.status_reset: Lead status is reset to 'new' (or previous status from activity log)
features_verified.fields_cleared: converted_to_listing_id and converted_at fields are cleared from the lead
features_verified.activity_log: Activity log is updated with 'unconverted' entry
features_verified.ui_button_visibility: UI buttons show/hide correctly based on lead status
features_verified.confirmation_dialogs: Two-step confirmation dialogs work (delete option + final confirmation)
features_verified.view_showcase_button: View Showcase Listing button navigates to listing page

seed_data_creation: None - used existing data from database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Un-convert feature is fully tested and working. The feature consists of: 1) Backend endpoint POST /api/property-leads/{lead_id}/unconvert?delete_listing=true/false 2) Frontend UI with conditional button rendering based on lead status 3) Two-step confirmation dialog for delete option and final confirmation. Test data includes leads '123 New Test Ave' (converted) and '123 Test Conversion Street' (new) which can be used for convert/unconvert testing cycles.

api_endpoints_tested.description: Un-converts a property lead, optionally deleting the associated showcase listing
Gets lead details including converted_to_listing_id for converted leads
Converts a lead to showcase listing (used for test setup)
